label: TP
reason: Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities. Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP because Math.random() generates unpredictable values used directly to construct the rememberMeKey stored in a session cookie, enabling session fixation attacks where an attacker controls the token. The resolved sink value depends entirely on the random number generator output. Alert 2 (java/xss) is also TP because the response.getWriter().println() statement concatenates user-supplied parameters (from request cookies) directly into the HTTP response body without sanitization. The resolved sink value includes user-controlled data from theCookie.getValue() which flows directly into the printed output.

evidence.note: Math.random() used insecurely to generate rememberMeKey for session management
User input from cookie values concatenated directly into response output without escaping
